title: States of a Clocked Machine
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be types, and let $R$ be a type of output-register values. A clock state is one of six forms: a run state carrying an optional element of $K$; a counter-scan state; an input-start state; an input-scan state; a decrement state carrying an element of $W$ and an element of $R$; or a return state carrying an element of $W$ and an element of $R$.
hypotheses_covered: A type $K$ for the optional run-state payload
A type $W$ for the decrement and return payloads
